sources.title: Climate change
sources.role: Planning practice guidance on mitigation and adaptation
sources.facts: Guidance links planning to mitigation, adaptation and climate evidence but does not itself determine site outcomes.
sources.guard: Strategic climate guidance is not a project carbon calculation, consent or site-specific resilience assessment.

sources.title: Renewable and low carbon energy
sources.role: Planning practice guidance for renewable energy
sources.facts: Guidance supports local policy development and identifies planning considerations for renewable and low-carbon energy.
sources.guard: Policy support does not establish technical feasibility, grid capacity, land rights, consent or viability.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Meeting the challenge of climate change, flooding and coastal change
sources.facts: Plans should support net zero and account for overheating, water scarcity, flood, coastal change, biodiversity and landscape effects.
sources.guard: National policy does not resolve exact-site risk, design compliance, energy yield or planning balance.

sources.title: Carbon budget and growth delivery plan
sources.facts: Published October 2025 and updated 23 June 2026; sets out national emissions-reduction delivery and related publications.
sources.guard: National delivery pathways are not parcel-level emissions, project approval, funding award or delivery guarantee.

sources.title: Unlocking the benefits of the clean energy economy
sources.facts: Updated 23 June 2026; describes energy security, jobs, health and environmental benefits and national delivery context.
sources.guard: A national policy narrative is not a local project pipeline, grid offer, investment commitment or consent.

sources.title: Overarching National Policy Statement for energy (EN-1), 2025
sources.facts: Published 6 January 2026 and applies to England and Wales; covers need, assessment principles and generic impacts.
sources.guard: NPS need and assessment policy do not grant development consent or prove site suitability.

sources.title: National Policy Statements for energy infrastructure
sources.facts: Updated 8 June 2026; covers overarching, generation, renewable, networks, nuclear and related assessments and consultations.
sources.guard: Collection inclusion does not establish which transitional policy applies to a specific application without date and scope checks.

sources.title: Energy digitalisation framework
sources.facts: Published 23 March 2026; sets vision, objectives, governance and implementation principles for energy digitalisation.
sources.guard: A digitalisation framework is not proof of dataset completeness, interoperability, cyber assurance or project delivery.
